definitions.explanation: A person who composes haiku poetry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう}→松尾芭蕉：30772_matsuobashou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{俳人|はいじん}だ。
examples.english: Matsuo Basho is a famous haiku poet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{俳人|はいじん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: She is active as a contemporary haiku poet.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{俳人|はいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{地|ち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Many haiku poets have visited this place.

notes:
{俳人|はいじん} refers to a person who composes ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧ (haiku), the traditional 5-7-5 syllable form of Japanese poetry.

FORMS:
{俳|はい} (haiku-related) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person). The same ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ suffix appears in ⟦{歌人|かじん}→歌人：20522_kajin⟧ (waka poet) and ⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧ (poet).

FAMOUS {俳人|はいじん}:
- ⟦{松尾|まつお}{芭蕉|ばしょう}→松尾芭蕉：30772_matsuobashou⟧ (Matsuo Basho) — Edo period, most celebrated
- {与謝|よさ}{蕪村|ぶそん} (Yosa Buson) — Edo period, also a painter
- {小林|こばやし}{一茶|いっさ} (Kobayashi Issa) — Edo period, known for warmth
- {正岡|まさおか}{子規|しき} (Masaoka Shiki) — Meiji period, modernized haiku

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歌人|かじん}→歌人：20522_kajin⟧: waka/tanka poet
- ⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧: poet (general, includes Western-style poetry)
- {俳人|はいじん} is specific to haiku; for someone who writes other forms of poetry, use ⟦{詩人|しじん}→詩人：03171_shijin⟧
